title: Getting started on devnet
lead: Five steps from sign-up to your first coupon. This is Solana devnet: the cash is test cash and the faucet refills it.

account.label: Account created
account.hint: You signed up and signed in.

walletLinked.label: Wallet linked
walletLinked.hint: Coupons and redemptions are paid to your Solana wallet.

kycApproved.label: KYC approved
kycApproved.hint: Identity review by the registrar (SIMULATED — decided by hand).

testCashReceived.label: Test cash received
testCashReceived.hint: Get test assets from the devnet faucet — 100,000 units per asset.

subscribed.label: First subscription
subscribed.hint: Subscribe to a bond in the primary placement.

faucet.success: Test {symbol} is on its way to your wallet
faucet.note: Devnet faucet: one request per asset per hour.

allDone: All steps complete — you are ready to invest.
